_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY. This is not a real car. The odometer, dates and policy values are illustrative, chosen to show a half-documented 12-year-old car. Replace every value with what you can prove for your own car, and leave null what you cannot.

baseline.note: Illustrative starting point. Replace with the last odometer reading you can prove with a document or a photo.

usage.notes: Unknown until two odometer readings exist. Ask before estimating a yearly rate.

open_questions: Timing belt: is there an invoice, and did it include the water pump and tensioner?
Odometer at the last belt change: needed to satisfy the kilometre half of the interval.
Engine code: confirm TU3JP on the engine plate, not only in the registration document.
Gearbox: confirm manual MA5 on a drive.
